messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Document:
The 2011 UEFA Champions League Final was a football match played on 28 May 2011 at Wembley Stadium in London that decided the winner of the 2010–11 season of the UEFA Champions League . The winners received the European Champion Clubs ' Cup ( the European Cup ) . The 2011 final was the culmination of the 56th season of the tournament , and the 19th in the Champions League era . The final was contested by Barcelona of Spain and Manchester United of England , the same teams which contested the 2009 final held in Rome which Barcelona won 2–0 . The match kicked off at 19:45 BST . The referee for the match was Viktor Kassai from Hungary . The venue , the new Wembley Stadium , hosted its first European Cup final , having opened in 2007 . The old Wembley Stadium hosted the finals in 1963 , 1968 , 1971 , 1978 and 1992 . Both teams entered the competition having won it three times previously , Manchester United in 1968 , 1999 and 2008 ; Barcelona in 1992 , 2006 and 2009 . To reach the final , in the knockout phase Barcelona beat Arsenal , Shakhtar Donetsk and lastly Real Madrid in the 212th `` El Clásico '' derby , while Manchester United beat Marseille , Chelsea and Schalke 04 . Manchester United and Barcelona entered the final as champions of their domestic leagues ( the Premier League and La Liga , respectively ) , but neither team had won a domestic cup that season . Barcelona dominated the match , winning 3–1 with goals from Pedro , Lionel Messi and David Villa , securing their fourth Champions League title . Wayne Rooney scored for Manchester United to level the score going into half-time . Barcelona thus qualified to play Porto , the winners of the 2010–11 UEFA Europa League , in the 2011 UEFA Super Cup in Monaco on 26 August 2011 , and they also earned a place in the semi-finals of the 2011 FIFA Club World Cup in December 2011 as the UEFA representative .
